svg.title: T03 Step-through underbone, 1958 onwards, left side elevation
svg.desc: Super Cub type step-through: pressed-steel backbone, leg shield, horizontal single-cylinder four-stroke under the backbone, semi-automatic gearbox with centrifugal clutch, leading-link fork, enclosed chain, drum brakes, fuel tank under the seat and rear carrier.

g.text: lamp, speedo and bars in one
keeps rain and mud off the rider
no clutch lever on the bar
chain runs in a dust-proof box
